passwordLogin.title: Sign In
passwordLogin.subtitle: Sign in with your user name or email and password
passwordLogin.emailCodeLink: Email me a sign-in code instead
passwordLogin.passwordLink: Sign in with a password instead

otp.label: Verification code
otp.sent: We emailed a 6-digit verification code to you. Enter it to finish signing in.
otp.resent: A new verification code is on its way.

errors.invalid: The user name, email or password is incorrect.
errors.otpInvalid: The verification code is incorrect or has expired.
errors.otpDeliveryFailed: We could not send your verification code. Try again shortly or contact your administrator.
errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. Sign-in is temporarily locked — try again later or reset your password.
errors.ssoRequired: Password sign-in is disabled for your organisation. Use single sign-on.

info.passwordReset: Your password has been updated. Please sign in.
info.verifyEmail: Account created. Sign in with your new password.
info.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Please sign in again.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.forcedDescription: Your administrator set a temporary password. Choose a new password to continue.
changePassword.description: Enter your current password and choose a new one.

security.title: Sign-in & security
security.description: Your user name, password and two-step verification.
security.usernameHint: 3–32 characters: lower-case letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores. You can sign in with it instead of your email.
security.twoStepHint: After your password, we email you a 6-digit code to finish signing in.

adminPassword.title: Set a temporary password
adminPassword.description: The member signs in with this password and must choose a new one straight away. Share it through a secure channel.
adminPassword.mustChange: Require a new password at next sign-in

forgot.description: Enter your email or user name and we will email you a link to set a new password.
forgot.error: Please enter your email or user name.

success.description: If an account matches what you entered, we sent a password reset link to its email address.
success.notice: The link can be used once and expires soon. If you don’t see the email, check your spam folder or ask your administrator to set a temporary password.

invite.createDescription: Set up your account to accept the invitation.
invite.signInDescription: You already have an account. Sign in and the invitation is accepted automatically.
